svg.title: STR26001 CuNiFe S-Type wiring reference
svg.desc: Numbered bench reference for three Fender CuNiFe single-coil pickups, a four-pole five-way super switch, DPDT parallel or series toggle, master volume and tone, treble bleed, ten operating states, and common ground.

g.text: MATCH IDENTICAL BOXED NET LABELS • FUNCTIONAL CONTACTS MUST BE METERED
Fender CuNiFe Stratocaster SSS • electrical roles, not lead colors
M_C is switched; isolated cover → GND
MIDDLE COVER MUST REMAIN GROUNDED WHEN M_C IS LIFTED
Common closes to one numbered throw per position
Poles B and C carry the same selected outer hot but have separate commons; OR and J never join.
In P2 / P4: BUS → M_H → M_C → B_H / N_H → GND
P1, P3, P5 are unchanged in either mode.
TREBLE BLEED • across BUS and OUT
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down • clockwise = louder
BUS feeds tone in all positions
REAR VIEW • shaft away • lugs down • clockwise = brighter
GND = B_C + N_C + separately isolated middle cover/shield • volume CCW lug • selector D3 • DPDT Y normal throw • tone cap return.
Bond other pickup shields/cases, pot cases, conductive switch chassis, cavity shield, bridge/string ground, and jack sleeve to GND.
Identify actual CuNiFe leads with Fender guide and meter. Confirm middle cover isolation, phase, super-switch lugs, and DPDT throws.
Meter all 10 states; tap-test pickup selection and confirm clockwise volume/tone action. Do not ground M_C outside the selector.
